datasets.title: Mauritania Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2021
datasets.description: Mauritania Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mauritania_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments across Mauritania in 2021 to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Results were spatially encoded as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) representing areas with different IPC phases, providing a time-series of food security impact classifications.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity across geographic areas.
